name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base

release_date.note: Baidu blog 'Product updates / November 5, 2026'; HF repo created 2026-10-21

weights.licence: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Model License Agreement v1.0

params.note: README: total includes embedding and head; active counts the head, not the embedding; both exclude 0.36B ECHO parameters

tokenizer.note: BPE; numbers split right-to-left in groups of up to three digits

mixers.note: Heavily Compressed Attention: one cached entry per 128 tokens plus a short window of recent tokens; heads of 512; 1 KV head
MLA with DSA top-2048; heads of 256 (192 + 64 RoPE), v 256

moe.router: Multi-Router: two sigmoid routers (gate.weight, gate.weight_1), aux-loss-free bias, learnable per-expert scalars and routed scale

stack.note: config compress_ratios: 128 for HCA, -2 for MLA at 0-based 7, 14, ... 42 (a 44th entry is for ECHO); layer 0 dense FFN, 1-42 latent MoE

steps.label: input_layernorm; read through the attention hyper-connection (mHC, 4 streams)
HCA: one cached entry per 128 tokens plus a 128-token window, 512-dim heads, sink; low-rank sigmoid gate; VHA post-mix
MLA + DSA indexer top-2048, plain RoPE; sigmoid gate; VHA post-mix
4096 -> 2048, top-10 of 512 SiTU-GLU experts, RMSNorm, -> 4096; shared expert (2048) on the full width; dense 14336 in layer 1

specials.name: mhc
specials.what: manifold-constrained hyper-connections: 4 parallel residual streams mixed by a constrained matrix (config hc_mult 4, Sinkhorn 20 iterations)
specials.where: around every sublayer and before the head

specials.name: hca
specials.what: Heavily Compressed Attention: every 128 tokens compressed to one cached entry, plus uncompressed recent tokens

specials.name: sparse_topk
specials.what: DSA indexer (64 heads x 128) keeps 2048 tokens

specials.name: vha
specials.what: Virtual Head Attention: low-rank post-mix across heads with identity skip (vha_postmix_U/V)

specials.name: gated_attention
specials.what: low-rank output gate computed from the query latent

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: ECHO: future-token prediction and speculative drafting; the README calls it a reuse of the final layer (0.36B extra), while the checkpoint stores a separate draft layer 43

specials.name: multimax
specials.what: output head with a learnable piecewise temperature (multimax_ranges, multimax_ts)

idx.note: hyper_connection tensors per sublayer; compressor and attn_sink in HCA layers; indexer and softmax_offset in MLA layers; vha_postmix_U/V; gate.weight and gate.weight_1; latent_norm; multimax

notes: attention.heads, kv_heads, head_dim, window and position describe the 37 HCA layers; the MLA layers are in layer_kinds.
HCA layers use compress_rope_theta 160000 with YaRN (factor 16 over 65,536) for queries, window keys and compressed entries; MLA layers use rope_theta 8,000,000 without YaRN (SGLang ernie55.py).
Raschka's gallery lists 'Gated HCA and MLA with DeepSeek Sparse Attention, VHA, and QK-Norm'; it agrees with the README.

The README says ECHO reuses the final layer with 0.36B extra parameters, but the checkpoint stores a full model.layers.43 (MLA + DSA, 512-expert MoE, e_proj/h_proj) that SGLang serves as a separate draft layer; the Hub count (286.25B) exceeds the README's 280B by about one MoE layer.

hca.note: YaRN factor 16; layer 1 has a dense FFN

mla_dsa.note: q/k head 192 + 64 RoPE dims, v 256; DSA top-2048; no YaRN
